nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of every holder in BunnyVerse.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing spenders' approved allowances.
Total token supply of BunnyVerse, set in the constructor.
Private owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and used for privileged checks.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Public constant decimals value (18) used for supply scaling.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) forwarding the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) that requires msg.sender == owner and performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
Public payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) owner-only mass transfer looping over recipients with unchecked multiplication.
Modifier ensure(address _from, address _to) computing the Uniswap pair via pairFor and restricting who may be transferred from/to.
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from an init code hash.
Payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) initializing metadata, supply, owner and the Uniswap allowance.
External caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and balance/allowance lookups.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address, executing untrusted code with this contract's storage.
Unchecked subtraction of _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] and balanceOf[_from] inside transferFrom (Solidity 0.5 wraps silently).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend allowing integer overflow of the total.
Parameter _to of transfer: recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer: amount to move.
Parameter _from of transferFrom: source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom: destination address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: amount to move.
Parameter _spender of approve: address granted the allowance.
Parameter _value of approve: allowance amount.
Parameter a of delegate: target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate: raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: array of recipient addresses.
Parameter _value of batchSend: amount sent to each recipient.
Loop index i iterating over _tos in batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Parameter _from of the ensure modifier.
Parameter _to of the ensure modifier.
Local UNI address computed by pairFor inside the ensure modifier.
Parameter factory of pairFor: Uniswap factory address.
Parameter tokenA of pairFor.
Parameter tokenB of pairFor.
Local pair address returned by pairFor.
Parameter _name of the constructor.
Parameter _symbol of the constructor.
Parameter _supply of the constructor used to derive totalSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom from transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is written as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is required to equal owner before the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
msg.sender is required to equal owner in batchSend.
msg.sender becomes owner and initial supply holder in the constructor.
_to parameter flows into transfer's forwarding call.
_value parameter flows into transfer's forwarding call.
_from parameter is used for balance and allowance mutations in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter is subtracted and added in transferFrom.
_spender parameter is the allowance target key in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
Address parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
Bytes parameter b is forwarded calldata in delegate.
_tos array drives the recipient loop in batchSend.
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
_value multiplies _tos.length without overflow protection, enabling the unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend.
Local total derived from unchecked multiplication is subtracted from balanceOf in batchSend.
Modifier parameter _from is compared against owner and UNI in ensure.
Modifier parameter _to is compared against owner in ensure.
Computed UNI pair address is used in the ensure authorization check.
factory parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor.
tokenA parameter participates in the sorted token hash in pairFor.
tokenB parameter participates in the sorted token hash in pairFor.
Local pair is the return value computed in pairFor.
transfer internally invokes transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure modifier which gates who may move tokens.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure reads the owner state variable for authorization.
owner state variable is read in delegate's privilege check.
owner state variable is read in batchSend's privilege check.
delegate performs an external delegatecall that transfers control to attacker-influenced code with this contract's storage.
Parameter a supplies the target address for the delegatecall operation.
Parameter b supplies the calldata for the delegatecall operation.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without safe math.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtractions on balances and allowances.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication of _value and _tos.length.
batchSend credits and debits the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
constructor grants an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router address.
Constructor parameter _name initializes the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply scales into totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as an argument of transfer and should collapse into that function node.
_value is only meaningful as an argument of transfer and should collapse into that function node.
_from is only meaningful within transferFrom's balance and allowance logic.
_to is only meaningful within transferFrom's crediting logic.
_value is only meaningful within transferFrom's arithmetic.
_spender is used solely as the allowance key written by approve.
_value is used solely as the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter a is consumed only as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is consumed only as delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
_tos array is used only to drive batchSend's recipient loop.
_value is used only for the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
Loop index i exists only to iterate inside batchSend.
Local total is computed and consumed exclusively inside batchSend.
_from exists only as an argument of the ensure modifier's authorization check.
_to exists only as an argument of the ensure modifier's authorization check.
Local UNI exists only inside the ensure modifier to validate the Uniswap pair.
factory is only used to derive the pair address inside pairFor.
tokenA is only used in the hash computation inside pairFor.
tokenB is only used in the hash computation inside pairFor.
Local pair is the exclusive return value computed inside pairFor.
_name is only consumed when the constructor initializes the name state variable.
_symbol is only consumed when the constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
_supply is only consumed when the constructor sets totalSupply and the initial balance.
